test_title: PYST 08: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the correct active form.

"Was the culprit being chased by the police?"

options.text: Had the police chased the culprit?
Did the police chase the culprit?
Was the police chasing the culprit?
Is the police chasing the culprit?

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Active voice structure: The subject performs the action directly.
 
• In the passive voice, the sentence is: "Was the culprit being chased by the police?"
 
• To convert to active voice: Place the subject "the police" at the beginning.
 
• Change the passive verb form "was being chased" to "was chasing" (past continuous active).
 
• Ensure the object "the culprit" remains at the end for clarity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Was the police chasing the culprit?"*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"Had the police chased the culprit?" – Incorrect tense (past perfect active).
 
• **Option 2: **"Did the police chase the culprit?" – Incorrect tense (past simple active).
 
• **Option 4: **"Is the police chasing the culprit?" – Incorrect tense (present continuous active).
